note: Scripture authority is the Open Word Bible (OWB), Amharic, Balanced edition (CC0), bundled as library/data/bible/owb-am-b.json.gz and read offline (owb-am). Every Scripture quotation was re-quoted to it verbatim (founder decision, 2026-11-18: Amharic quotes OWB everywhere), replacing the 1962 UBS wording and translator-rendered verses the first edition carried.

A `mined` row is a verbatim OWB span in that chapter's block (block_index -1 is the chapter title): the whole verse, verses joined, the shortest contiguous span carrying the quoted clause, or OWB pieces joined with '…'. The Luke 11:1 refrain is «ጌታ ሆይ፣ … እንዴት መጸለይ እንዳለብን አስተምረን» everywhere.

`self_rendered` rows are allusions and paraphrases in the author's own voice, the author's adaptations of a verse to 'me'/'us' (Lord, teach me to pray; Heb 7:25's 'always lives to intercede for us', worded with OWB's vocabulary), and the Lord's Prayer doxology, which OWB, following the critical text, does not carry.
